notes.title: Prepare your next trip !
notes.content:
Summer is HERE !
You already visited every country ? Bored of basic holiday location and want an authentic experience ?
Come take a look at Mahan !

A cultural center near the beach !
Mahan loves its crystal blue waters as much as educating citizens and tourists.

Thanks to its vast international protection program, you can witness the wonders of every culture of the world in our conservation centers and enjoy a fun beach time on the same day !

It isn't recommended to ask silly questions about the protection program, any tourist referring to it as [spoiler]"interventionism"[/spoiler] or [spoiler]"stolen artifacts"[/spoiler] will be promptly asked to leave.


More lore, more flavor
For this update I really wanted to have fun and just build some world lore and folklore, not feel restricted by actual events or legends.

It will also treat a real issue similar to the one in Case 2, be prepared.


Actual content
Case 5 will be added

Heavily based on the search engine

A lot of clues to find

Bonus old wallpaper and cold cigarette smell for those with SteamOdorama devices



I'm approaching the polishing and testing phase of the case, expect the update for [spoiler]REDACTED by Mahan Internal Security Servicies[/spoiler]

notes.title: Small patch for spelling errors
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you all for your feedback.

English isn't my first language, and I'm working alone on that project, so errors are more than likely.
Also, I may have dyslexia or something like that, so please advertise the game, more money = Possible diagnosis lol

I finally looked at the community tab, hadn't thought that people would use it and I was a bit too focused on building the tutorial, level 4 and 5 for the EA launch.
Keep using the community tab for feedback and questions, I'll do my best to answer and improve the game.


 Compelling fixed
 Apartment fixed

notes.title: Early Access Release date and Pricing
notes.content:
New Investigations awaits

First of all, my thanks to everyone that wishlisted and left positive reviews, I didn't expect such engagement and feedbacks.

As for the real info as stated in the title, I'll release the early access of Window Of Perspectives at this date :
19 May 2025

Content added

2 new levels with new gameplay mechanics are ready to go and a Tutorial Level has been added, which will also be released in the demo version for curious players.

Of course a few bugs, spelling errors and minor details have been added. I won't list them all, since you're all investigators I'll let you find them !

Prices, Money, Bucks, Valuable Value

Being a solo dev with little to no income, I'll ask for a small payment, around 5 Euro/USD.

Since I don't know about every economic situation, I mostly let Steam do Local Pricing, so don't hesitate to leave a review regarding specific prices, I'll try my best to adapt accordingly.




There's not much more to say, I hope you will like what I did and stick with me for more levels and mysteries.
